title: Found this thread!
content: I googled “I always dream I’m in a mall” and found this thread and I’m just 1 more person who can relate 100% in a 32yr old male. I always dream I’m in a mall with a water slide amusement park. With many stores and elevators and hotel rooms and there’s always an airport near by. It’s always crowded and I’m usually walking in and out of bars and restaraunts before going in a gas station to buy weed edibles. I also go into the bathroom and it has like 20 stalls even showers sometimes. Everyone is always moving and seems to be on there way somewhere like walking while talking. I am going to start a dream journal and see if I can figure out what’s going on. I’m a recovering alcoholic and I feel like there’s always a night time bar scene , lots of bars and cigarettes and weed shopping in weird old gas station stores. I don’t know if that’s from my own experiences or if you guys get that bar restaraunt experience.
